name: How do I know if my existing plumbing is compatible with a new sink?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my existing plumbing is compatible with a new sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most new kitchen sinks are designed to be compatible with standard plumbing connections. However, significant changes in sink type (e.g., single basin to double basin, or a deeper sink) might require minor adjustments to the drain lines or P-trap to ensure proper slope and alignment. If you're relocating the sink or adding features like a garbage disposal, more extensive plumbing work, potentially involving drain line modifications or new water supply lines, might be necessary. A professional assessment is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most new sinks fit standard plumbing, but deep or multi-basin sinks, or feature additions like disposals, may need minor drain or supply line adjustments.
